question: What transition marks the completion of the sun-storey teaching and the start of the thirteen-storey teaching?
premises: The sun-storey has been fully declared.
The listener is commanded to hear about the thirteen-storey design.
inference: The teaching on the sun-storey is concluded and the exposition of the thirteen-storey design begins.
plain_english: Thus the sun-storey has been declared; now hear about the thirteen-storeyed structure.
